verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can describe what they want in chat and Activepieces builds the agent or automation. They also show plain-language editing of agents, and a built-in MCP server lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables and test automations through natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed, and documentation that the in-product chat (not just an external MCP client) covers operations beyond building and editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
describe a change in the editor — "only reply to paying customers" — and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you
Write "summarise my unread emails every morning" and you get a drafted agent — a name, instructions, and the tools it needs
